why: Parsnips planted today are ready on Spring 5, so plant before anything else.

tasks.text: Plant and water the 15 Parsnip Seeds
Chop trees and clear weeds with the energy you have left
Walk into Pelican Town and introduce yourself to everyone
Look at Pierre's seeds; he is open 9am to 5pm

why: Willy's letter arrives today, and he gives you a Bamboo Pole.

tasks.text: Water the parsnips
Meet Willy on the beach for the Bamboo Pole
Forage Daffodil in Pelican Town for the Spring Foraging bundle
Fish the ocean for a Sardine (6am to 7pm), an Ocean Fish bundle item
Check seed prices at Pierre before the Wednesday closure

why: Parsnips are ready, and the Mines and the Community Center open today.

tasks.text: Harvest the parsnips; keep 1 for the Spring Crops bundle and ship or sell the rest
Buy Potato Seeds, Green Bean seeds, Cauliflower Seeds and more Parsnip Seeds, then plant them
Enter Pelican Town from the bus stop between 8am and 1pm on a sunny day to see Lewis open the Community Center
A JojaMart membership costs 5,000g; plan your cash around it instead of bundles
The Mines are open from today; visit floor 1 to break rocks for Stone
